record.summary: Cambodia's draft national AI strategy, prepared by the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications and put to public consultation in June 2025. Of its six priorities and 41 measures, priority 5, 'ethical and responsible AI', takes a light-touch, step-by-step approach that starts with supply-side regulation and direct regulation of high-risk applications. It directs a National AI Governance Framework from national to enterprise level, risk assessments by sector and key institution, datasets for safety evaluation of AI models, rules against abuse of AI-generated content, and studies of a regulatory sandbox and an AI incident response mechanism.
record.notes: MPTC drafted the strategy over more than a year with the support of UN-ESCAP, held two rounds of technical consultation with UN-ESCAP experts on 19 February and 18 March 2025 and a deep-dive workshop on 7-8 April 2025, and held 10 bilateral and multilateral consultations with ministries and institutions between 9 and 20 May 2025. MPTC's announcement, posted under 1 June 2025 on its English site, opened a public consultation until 20 June 2025 and planned a stakeholder meeting in the third week of June and a national workshop in the first week of July 2025. The draft dated June 2025 calls itself a living document; implementation would run through the Digital Government Committee and an inter-ministerial working group on AI, with annual action plans, achievement reports at the end of 2026 and 2028 and an evaluation by the end of 2030. It notes Cambodia's support for the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI and its part in the ASEAN Working Group on AI Governance and the Hiroshima AI Process Friends Group. The OECD.AI Policy Navigator, updated by Cambodia's national contact point on 9 June 2026, still lists the strategy as proposed or under development.

The draft was read in full for priority 5, the 41 measures and the implementation mechanism. The draft stored is the one OECD.AI links; whether it is the same text MPTC put to consultation is not stated in it. Version 1's announcement number (1497), the date 11 June 2025 for the announcement, 'some 34 ministries' and 'version 5' came from law-firm and Open Development Cambodia summaries and rest on no stored file; they were removed or replaced by what the MPTC pages say (posted under 1 June 2025; 10 consultation meetings, 9-20 May 2025). Version 1's summary said risk assessments 'by sector and key application'; the draft says 'by sector and by key institutions'. No adoption decision appears in any stored file.

summary.quote: this strategy outlines 6 strategic priorities comprising of 41 strategic measures.

Cambodia adopts a light-touch approach to AI governance in line with regional and global trends and builds a regulatory framework step by step as AI technology evolves, starting with strengthening supply-side regulation and direct regulation for high -risk applications.
5.1. Prepare the National AI Governance Framework to harmonize governance from the national through sectoral to the enterprise levels.
5.5. Promote and support risk assessments of the use of artificial intelligence by sector and by key institutions
5.6. Conduct a feasibility study for setting up a (regulatory) sandbox artificial intelligence. 5.7. Study the preparation of a response mechanism for artificial intelligence incidents.
Create and disseminate datasets for safety evaluation of AI models for Cambodian context
Prepare new regulation or update existing regulation to combat abuse of AI - generated or manipulated content

judgment.status_reasoning: The draft is dated June 2025 and MPTC opened a public consultation on it until 20 June 2025, planning a national workshop in July 2025. The OECD.AI entry, updated by Cambodia's national contact point on 9 Jun 2026 and stored on 18 Oct 2026, still lists the strategy as 'Proposed or under development'. No stored file shows an adoption. 'Draft / proposed' with legal force 'Proposed' stands.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published 2025-06: the draft's cover says June 2025 and MPTC's consultation announcement sets a deadline of 20 June 2025; neither gives a day for the draft itself. The announcement is posted under 1 June 2025 on MPTC's English site (in notes).
judgment.scope_reasoning: Draft national AI strategy with a priority on ethical and responsible AI that directs a national AI governance framework, risk assessments, safety-evaluation datasets and direct regulation of high-risk applications; in scope with no note, as in version 1.
